System Architecture and Build Phases (simulation-only, ManiSkill3)
PHASE LEGEND — box color = phase that builds it
Setup — repo scaffold, ManiSkill3 install, humanoid asset import
Baseline Task Policies — per-task PPO/SAC policies, whole-body controller
Failure Injection — seeded, severity-parameterized failure API
Failure Detector — threshold to ensemble to sequence-model monitor
Recovery Policy (core deliverable) — skill library + arbiter + full eval
Generalization & Benchmark — held-out eval, benchmark packaging
Writeup & Polish — repo cleanup, demo video, blog post
